reports.title: Kulicke & Soffa Reports Fourth Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: K&S currently expects net revenue in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 ending January 2, 2027 to be approximately $410 million +/- $20 million, GAAP diluted EPS to be approximately $1.48 +/- 10%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS to be approximately $1.65 +/- 10%.
A reconciliation between the GAAP and non-GAAP financial outlook is provided in the financial tables included at the end of this press release.
